analysis.summary: Manaksia Steels Limited reported record financial performance for FY 2025-26, crossing the INR 1,000 Crore revenue milestone with significant improvements in EBITDA, profit after tax, and return metrics. Management highlighted the successful commissioning of its new Alu-Zinc coating line and the augmentation of its existing colour-coated line during the year. The company remains focused on expanding its value-added coated steel portfolio while maintaining a conservative, low-debt balance sheet and self-funding capital expenditures. Manaksia Steels Limited is undertaking capacity expansions in Alu-Zinc and colour-coated steel lines, funded through internal accruals, to enhance value addition and scale. Management reported a decline in revenues, EBITDA, and PAT for FY 2024-25 due to lower realisations and market challenges, while sales volumes increased.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 85 Crores funded through internal accruals for a new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 110,800 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The first expansion programme will comprise the addition of the Company’s new integrated Alu-Zinc production line of 1,10,800 TPA, which would result in consolidated annual revenues of H1,000 Crore at peak capacity during a financial year. This investment of H85 Crore was funded through internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A second expansion programme of 40 Crores comprises a new colour coating manufacturing line that will enhance manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.
capex_expansion.quote: The second expansion programme of H40 Crore will comprise the addition of a new colour coating manufacturing line. This will enhance the Company’s manufacturing capacity from 48,000 TPA to 140,000 TPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges during the last financial year.
margins_costs.quote: During the last financial year, our EBITDA margin weakened on account of a decline in revenues and market challenges.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that the global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector and lower price realizations.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global economic environment remains fragile, leading to weakened demand in the steel sector, which has resulted in lower price realizations.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
